name: jQuery UI Slider
project_description: Compatibility shim that re-provides the jQuery UI Slider widget assets that were removed from Drupal core. Drupal core deprecated and removed the bundled jQuery UI libraries (change record https://www.drupal.org/node/3067969); this module makes the Slider library available again as the Drupal asset library jquery_ui_slider/slider so themes and modules that still reference core/jquery.ui.slider can migrate to jquery_ui_slider/slider. The module itself contains no PHP, routes, config or assets: it declares the dependency on the jquery_ui base module, which registers the library (and ships the actual JS/CSS) on the shim's behalf via hook_library_info_alter(). jQuery UI is End-of-Life; the project documentation recommends selecting a modern replacement rather than depending on jQuery UI in new code.
